lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Y2Ti8O24 (SrYT4O12) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 36 atoms in the unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Ti and Y centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, while Sr adopts a 12-coordinate close-packed-like local arrangement. Ti-centered octahedra share corners and edges with one another and share faces with the 12-vertex Sr polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 36 sites.
